The national workbook exposes semantic IDs `crop_national_table_01` through
`crop_national_table_17`. Parsers cover national/state totals, current state
snapshots, national histories, recent state production, supply/disposal and
quarterly prices. The state workbook parser covers Australia and six states,
including compact/spaced sheet aliases.

Statuses come from explicit `s` and `f` suffixes. Periods without explicit
source status remain `published-unclassified`. March and non-March table-shape
variants are selected using title and structural fingerprints rather than
sheet position.
